scanNote:
12-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (83-bet) - O'QISh MATNI va LUG'AT.

Yuqorida o'ngda KO'K-YaShIL yorliqda oq '12', chapida 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP TOMON - KO'K FON, MEHMONXONA SURATI (qizil g'ishtli bino, oq balkonlar, soyabonlar, ko'l). Oq sarlavha 'Alton Towers - Where the Magic Never Ends!'
1-xatboshi: 'The Alton Towers Hotel IS SET in the HEART of Staffordshire's scenic countryside in the north-west of England. It is only minutes away from Britain's most magical THEME PARK, Alton Towers. Like the park, the hotel offers guests the chance to EXPERIENCE a delightful holiday full of fun and surprises.'
2: 'The first thing you'll NOTICE when you enter the hotel is the EXTRAORDINARY reception desk, which is made of piles of antique luggage, and a flying machine which STRETCHES up to the ceiling! The hotel also offers an amazing range of themed rooms and suites. These INCLUDE The Peter Rabbit Bedrooms, the Garden Rooms, the Explorer Room, the Cadbury's Chocolate Bedroom, the Coca-Cola Fizzy Factory Room, and the Arabian Nights Suite, which is possibly the most romantic hotel suite in the world. All the bedrooms and suites have a bathroom, tea- and coffee-making facilities, satellite TV and a baby-listening facility.'
3: 'You'll never get bored at the Alton Towers Hotel, even during rainy or cold weather! After a THRILLING day at the park, you can RELAX in the pool at the Pirate's Lagoon. Kids can join Pirate Bill's Club, which is a great OPPORTUNITY to make new friends while taking part in games, drawing, FACE-PAINTING and lots more, with Pirate Bill himself! The Secret Garden Restaurant offers delicious dishes from around the world, while the hotel's two bars, the Dragon Bar and the Captain's Bar, are both ideal places to relax with a coffee or a cocktail in the evening.'
4: 'The Alton Towers Hotel is the ideal place for a fun family holiday at any time of year, but don't forget that the theme park is only open from mid-March to the end of October. Remember, Alton Towers is the LAND where the magic never ends, so book early! Please check our PRICE GUIDE for current prices.'
Pastda SARIQ QUTI: c) 'Read the text again and answer the questions.' 1 Where is the hotel? 2 What can you find in the hotel lobby? 3 What facilities do the bedrooms and suites have? 4 What can you do at the hotel? 5 When can you stay at the hotel?

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development'.
5) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Qiya: 'theme, price, rainy, hotel, ideal, family, satellite, current, flying, reception'. 1 a ..... park 2 a ..... desk 3 a ..... machine 4 ..... weather 5 a ..... suite 6 ..... TV 7 an ..... place 8 a ..... holiday 9 a ..... guide 10 ..... prices.
6) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' 1 set ..... the heart ..... Staffordshire; 2 ..... the north-west ..... England; 3 minutes ..... ..... Alton Towers; 4 full ..... fun; 5 stretches ..... ..... the ceiling; 6 a range ..... rooms and suites; 7 the most romantic hotel suite ..... the world; 8 to relax ..... the pool; 9 the ideal place ..... a holiday ..... any time ..... year.
7) 'Fill in the correct verb from the list.' Qiya: 'book, joined, made, offers, gets'. 1 Tim often ..... bored at home during the school holidays. 2 Rachel and Brian ..... the sailing club last summer. 3 I ..... a lot of new friends at the camp. 4 You should ..... a room at the hotel before you go. 5 This bar ..... a wide selection of cocktails.
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the text in Ex. 4 again, then make notes under these headings. Use your notes to talk about the Alton Towers Hotel.' Ko'k nuqtalar: • Name/Location/Why special • Description • What you can do there • Recommendation.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '83'.

exercises.instructionEn: Alton Towers - Where the Magic Never Ends!
exercises.instructionUz: Alton Towers - Sehr hech qachon tugamaydigan joy!
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Alton Towers mehmonxonasi
Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi
Staffordshirning go'zal qishloq
manzarasi markazida joylashgan. U
Britaniyaning eng sehrli mavzuli
istirohat bog'i Alton Towers'dan
bir necha daqiqa masofada. Bog' kabi,
mehmonxona ham mehmonlarga
qiziqarli va kutilmagan hodisalarga
to'la yoqimli ta'tilni boshdan
kechirish imkonini beradi.

2) Mehmonxonaga kirganingizda
payqaydigan birinchi narsa - eski
jomadonlar uyumidan yasalgan
g'ayrioddiy qabulxona stoli va
shiftgacha cho'zilgan uchuvchi
mashina! Mehmonxona ajoyib mavzuli
xonalar va lyuks xonalar ham taklif
qiladi. Bularga Peter Rabbit
yotoqxonalari, Bog' xonalari, Sayyoh
xonasi, Cadbury's Shokolad
yotoqxonasi, Coca-Cola Gazli zavod
xonasi va ehtimol dunyodagi eng
romantik mehmonxona xonasi - Arab
kechalari lyuks xonasi kiradi. Barcha
yotoqxona va lyuks xonalarda
hammom, choy-qahva tayyorlash
jihozlari, sun'iy yo'ldosh TV va
chaqaloqni eshitish qurilmasi bor.

3) Alton Towers mehmonxonasida
hatto yomg'irli yoki sovuq havoda ham
hech qachon zerikmaysiz! Bog'dagi
hayajonli kundan keyin Pirate's
Lagoon basseynida dam olishingiz
mumkin. Bolalar Pirate Bill klubiga
qo'shilishi mumkin - bu o'yinlar,
rasm chizish, yuzga rasm chizish va
boshqa ko'p narsalarda qatnashib,
Pirate Bill'ning o'zi bilan yangi
do'stlar orttirish uchun ajoyib
imkoniyat! Secret Garden restorani
dunyo bo'ylab mazali taomlarni
taklif qiladi, mehmonxonaning ikki
bari - Dragon Bar va Captain's Bar
esa kechqurun qahva yoki kokteyl
bilan dam olish uchun ideal joylar.

4) Alton Towers mehmonxonasi yilning
istalgan vaqtida qiziqarli oilaviy
ta'til uchun ideal joy, lekin
unutmang - mavzuli bog' faqat mart
o'rtasidan oktyabr oxirigacha ochiq.
Eslang, Alton Towers - sehr hech
qachon tugamaydigan o'lka, shuning
uchun erta bron qiling! Joriy narxlar
uchun narxlar ko'rsatkichimizni
tekshiring.


⚠ 'SCENIC':

  = manzarali, go'zal.
  ⚠ 'scenery' = manzara.


⚠ 'DELIGHTFUL':

  = yoqimli, maroqli.


⚠ 'A RANGE OF':

  = turli xil, keng tanlov.


⚠ 'POSSIBLY':

  = ehtimol.


⚠ 'SATELLITE TV':

  = sun'iy yo'ldosh televideniyesi.


⚠ 'TO GET BORED':

  = zerikmoq.
  ⚠ 'bored' - odam; 'boring' -
  narsa.


⚠ 'A LAGOON':

  = lagun (ko'lmak).


⚠ 'TO TAKE PART IN':

  = qatnashmoq.


⚠ 'A DISH':

  = taom (yoki idish).


⚠ 'WHILE':

  bu yerda = ...esa (qarama-qarshi
  qo'yish), 'davomida' emas.


⚠ 'MID-MARCH':

  = mart o'rtasi.
  ⚠ 'mid-' = o'rta.


⚠ 'CURRENT':

  = joriy, hozirgi.

points.uz: Alton Towers mehmonxonasi Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi Staffordshirning go'zal qishloq manzarasi markazida joylashgan. U Britaniyaning eng sehrli mavzuli istirohat bog'i Alton Towers'dan bir necha daqiqa masofada.
points.noteUz: ⚠ 'is set in' = joylashgan; 'minutes away from' = bir necha daqiqa masofada.

points.en: Like the park, the hotel offers guests the chance to experience a delightful holiday full of fun and surprises.
points.uz: Bog' kabi, mehmonxona ham mehmonlarga qiziqarli va kutilmagan hodisalarga to'la yoqimli ta'tilni boshdan kechirish imkonini beradi.

These include The Peter Rabbit Bedrooms, the Garden Rooms, the Explorer Room, the Cadbury's Chocolate Bedroom, the Coca-Cola Fizzy Factory Room, and the Arabian Nights Suite, which is possibly the most romantic hotel suite in the world.

points.en: All the bedrooms and suites have a bathroom, tea- and coffee-making facilities, satellite TV and a baby-listening facility.
points.uz: Barcha yotoqxona va lyuks xonalarda hammom, choy-qahva tayyorlash jihozlari, sun'iy yo'ldosh TV va chaqaloqni eshitish qurilmasi bor.

points.uz: Bolalar Pirate Bill klubiga qo'shilishi mumkin - bu o'yinlar, rasm chizish, yuzga rasm chizish va boshqa ko'p narsalarda qatnashib, Pirate Bill'ning o'zi bilan yangi do'stlar orttirish uchun ajoyib imkoniyat!

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni yana o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR MATNDAN:

  1 Staffordshire, Angliyaning
    shimoli-g'arbi

items.answerEn: It is in the heart of Staffordshire's countryside, in the north-west of England, minutes away from the Alton Towers theme park.
items.answerUz: U Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi Staffordshir qishloq joyining markazida, Alton Towers mavzuli bog'idan bir necha daqiqa masofada.

items.en: 2 What can you find in the hotel lobby?
items.answerEn: An extraordinary reception desk made of piles of antique luggage and a flying machine which stretches up to the ceiling.

items.en: 3 What facilities do the bedrooms and suites have?
items.uz: 3 Yotoqxona va lyuks xonalarda qanday qulayliklar bor?

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, keyin to'ldirilgan iboralar bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (matndan):

  1 set IN the heart OF
    Staffordshire
  2 IN the north-west OF England
  3 minutes AWAY FROM Alton Towers
  4 full OF fun
  5 stretches UP TO the ceiling
  6 a range OF rooms and suites
  7 the most romantic hotel suite IN
    the world
  8 to relax IN the pool
  9 the ideal place FOR a holiday AT
    any time OF year


⚠ PREDLOGLI IBORALAR:

  in the heart of = markazida
  in the north-west of =
    shimoli-g'arbida
  away from = ...dan masofada
  full of = ...ga to'la
  up to = ...gacha
  a range of = turli
  in the world = dunyoda
  in the pool = basseynda
  for a holiday = ta'til uchun
  at any time = istalgan vaqtda
  of year = yilning

items.textEn: 7 the most romantic hotel suite ___ the world
9 the ideal place ___ a holiday ___ any time ___ year
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'FOR a holiday AT any time OF year'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct verb from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 Tim often GETS bored ...
  2 Rachel and Brian JOINED the
    sailing club ...
  3 I MADE a lot of new friends ...
  4 You should BOOK a room ...
  5 This bar OFFERS a wide
    selection ...


⚠ FE'L BIRIKMALARI:

  get bored = zerikmoq
  join a club = klubga a'zo bo'lmoq
  make friends = do'st orttirmoq
  book a room = xona bron qilmoq
  offer a selection = tanlov taklif
    qilmoq


⚠ 'A SAILING CLUB':

  = yelkanli qayiq klubi.


⚠ 'A WIDE SELECTION':

  = keng tanlov.

items.sentence: 1 Tim often ___ bored at home during the school holidays.

items.sentence: 4 You should ___ a room at the hotel before you go.
items.uz: Borishdan oldin mehmonxonada xona bron qilishingiz kerak.

items.sentence: 5 This bar ___ a wide selection of cocktails.
items.uz: Bu bar keng kokteyl tanlovini taklif qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text in Ex. 4 again, then make notes under these headings. Use your notes to talk about the Alton Towers Hotel. • Name/Location/Why special • Description • What you can do there • Recommendation
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashqdagi matnni yana o'qing, keyin ushbu sarlavhalar ostida qaydlar yozing. Qaydlaringizdan Alton Towers mehmonxonasi haqida gapirish uchun foydalaning. • Nomi/Joylashuvi/Nega alohida • Tavsif • U yerda nima qilish mumkin • Tavsiya
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  NAME/LOCATION/WHY SPECIAL:
    Alton Towers Hotel;
    Staffordshire, NW England; next
    to theme park; magic never ends
  DESCRIPTION:
    reception desk of antique
    luggage; flying machine; themed
    rooms & suites; bathroom, TV,
    baby-listening
  WHAT YOU CAN DO:
    pool, Pirate Bill's Club,
    restaurant, two bars
  RECOMMENDATION:
    ideal for family holiday; book
    early


⚠ 'A RECOMMENDATION':

  = tavsiya.
  ⚠ 'to recommend' = tavsiya
  qilmoq.


⚠ 'LOCATION':

  = joylashuv.
exercises.exampleEn: The Alton Towers Hotel is in Staffordshire, in the north-west of England. It is special because it is next to Britain's most magical theme park.
exercises.exampleUz: Alton Towers mehmonxonasi Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi Staffordshirda. U alohida, chunki Britaniyaning eng sehrli mavzuli bog'i yonida.
modelAnswers: The hotel has an extraordinary reception desk made of antique luggage and a flying machine. It has themed rooms and suites, and every room has a bathroom, satellite TV and a baby-listening facility.
At the hotel you can relax in the pool, kids can join Pirate Bill's Club, and you can eat at the Secret Garden Restaurant or have a drink in one of the two bars.
I think it's an ideal place for a family holiday. You should book early because it's very popular.
modelAnswersUz: Mehmonxonada eski jomadonlardan yasalgan g'ayrioddiy qabulxona stoli va uchuvchi mashina bor. Unda mavzuli xonalar va lyuks xonalar bor, har xonada hammom, sun'iy yo'ldosh TV va chaqaloqni eshitish qurilmasi bor.
Mehmonxonada basseynda dam olish mumkin, bolalar Pirate Bill klubiga qo'shilishi mumkin, Secret Garden restoranida ovqatlanish yoki ikki bardan birida ichimlik ichish mumkin.
Menimcha, bu oilaviy ta'til uchun ideal joy. Erta bron qilishingiz kerak, chunki u juda mashhur.
